description: Source code defining the Post data model and related functions for Mattermost, including post validation, cloning, serialization, and reporting query handling.

classes.name: Post
classes.description: Represents a message post in Mattermost, including content, metadata, and related properties.

classes.name: PostEphemeral
classes.description: Represents a temporary post visible to a specific user.

classes.name: PostPatch
classes.description: Used for updating existing posts with partial data.

classes.name: PostReminder
classes.description: Contains data for scheduled reminders associated with posts.

classes.name: PostPriority
classes.description: Defines priority and acknowledgment settings for posts.

classes.name: PostPersistentNotifications
classes.description: Tracks persistent notification data for posts.

classes.name: GetPersistentNotificationsPostsParams
classes.description: Parameters for fetching posts with persistent notifications.

classes.name: MoveThreadParams
classes.description: Parameters for moving a thread to a different channel.

classes.name: AnalyticsPostCountsOptions
classes.description: Options for aggregating post counts for analytics.

classes.name: ReportPostOptions
classes.description: Options for querying posts for reporting and compliance.

classes.name: RewriteRequest
classes.description: Request structure for rewriting message content via AI or other services.

classes.name: RewriteResponse
classes.description: Response structure containing rewritten message text.

classes.name: ReportPostOptionsCursor
classes.description: Opaque cursor for paginating report queries.

classes.name: ReportPostListResponse
classes.description: Response containing a list of posts and next cursor for pagination.

classes.name: ReportPostQueryParams
classes.description: Resolved query parameters for fetching posts in store layer.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of post data for auditing purposes.

methods.name: LogClone
methods.description: Returns a clone of the post's audit data.

methods.name: ShallowCopy
methods.description: Copies post data into another post object without locking.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the post.

methods.name: ToJSON
methods.description: Serializes the post to a JSON string.

methods.name: EncodeJSON
methods.description: Encodes the post as JSON into an io.Writer.

methods.name: PreSave
methods.description: Prepares the post before saving, generating IDs and timestamps.

methods.name: PreCommit
methods.description: Performs final preparations before saving the post.

methods.name: MakeNonNil
methods.description: Ensures props are initialized.

methods.name: DelProp
methods.description: Deletes a property from the post's props.

methods.name: AddProp
methods.description: Adds or updates a property in the post's props.

methods.name: GetProps
methods.description: Returns the post's properties.

methods.name: SetProps
methods.description: Sets the post's properties.

methods.name: GetProp
methods.description: Retrieves a specific property value.

methods.name: ValidateProps
methods.description: Validates all known properties for correctness.

methods.name: propsIsValid
methods.description: Performs detailed validation of properties, returning errors if invalid.

methods.name: IsSystemMessage
methods.description: Checks if the post is a system message.

methods.name: IsRemote
methods.description: Determines if the post originated remotely.

methods.name: GetRemoteID
methods.description: Safely retrieves the remote ID.

methods.name: IsJoinLeaveMessage
methods.description: Checks if the post is a join/leave message.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to update post fields.

methods.name: ChannelMentions
methods.description: Extracts channel mentions from the message.

methods.name: ChannelMentionsAll
methods.description: Gets all mentions from message and attachments.

methods.name: DisableMentionHighlights
methods.description: Disables mention highlights and returns first mention.

methods.name: DisableMentionHighlights (PostPatch)
methods.description: Disables mention highlights in a post patch.

methods.name: findAtChannelMention
methods.description: Finds @channel, @all, or @here mentions in message.

methods.name: Attachments
methods.description: Retrieves message attachments.

methods.name: AttachmentsEqual
methods.description: Checks if attachments are equal between posts.

methods.name: WithRewrittenImageURLs
methods.description: Returns a copy with rewritten image URLs.

methods.name: RewriteImageURLs
methods.description: Rewrites image URLs in markdown message.

methods.name: IsFromOAuthBot
methods.description: Checks if post is from an OAuth bot.

methods.name: ToNilIfInvalid
methods.description: Returns nil if post ID is invalid.

methods.name: ForPlugin
methods.description: Returns a clone suitable for plugin use.

methods.description: Retrieves preview post from metadata.

methods.description: Gets previewed post ID property.

methods.description: Retrieves post priority from metadata.

methods.name: GetPersistentNotification
methods.description: Gets persistent notification setting.

methods.name: GetRequestedAck

methods.name: IsUrgent
methods.description: Checks if post has urgent priority.
